install: curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" && cd /workspace/cortex && uv venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && uv pip install -e ".[api,dms]" && uv pip install playwright && python -m playwright install chromium && cd /workspace/openvault/OpenMW && uv sync

terminals.name: demo-stack
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; export OPENVAULT_ROOT=/workspace/openvault; bash /workspace/cortex/scripts/start_demo_stack.sh; tail -f /workspace/cortex/demo/logs/cortex.out.log
